title: Stufen content pack manifest
description: content/<lang>/pack.json. One per language pack. Declares code, version, sources and checksum.

code.description: Two letter language code. Must match the directory name and the prefix of every key in the pack.

version.description: Semantic version of the pack. See docs/09-content-pack-spec.md, Versioning.

name_native.description: Language name in the language itself.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale used for speech, for example de-DE.

levels.description: Levels this pack version ships content for.

sources.description: Every published source the pack cites. Items, descriptors and exercises reference these by id.

checksum.description: sha256 over every content file except pack.json. Written by scripts/validate-content.mjs --write-checksum. 'pending' is allowed while editing.

strictUnitEnding.description: Default true. When false the validator does not require each unit to end with a production lesson and a review lesson. Only for skeleton packs.

updated.description: Date of the last content change, ISO date.

id.description: Short stable id used in every source field, for example cefr-cv-2020.

note.description: Edition, page range, or what is still to be verified.
